parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword of the SQL statement.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The order of fields in the console. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: QueryCondition
parameters.description:
The filter condition on queries. Specify the value in the JSON format. Valid values:

*   `{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: filters the top 100 queries that are the most time-consuming.

*   `{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: filters completed queries.

*   `{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: filters running queries.

*   `{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: filters the queries that consume a period of 30 milliseconds to less than 50 milliseconds. You can customize a filter condition by setting **Min** and **Max**.

    *   If only **Min** is specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is greater than the Min value are filtered.
    *   If only **Max** is specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is less than the Max value are filtered.
    *   If both **Min** and **Max** are specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is greater than or equal to the **Min** value and less than or equal to the **Max** value are filtered.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The name of the database account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-diagnosis-records --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --start-time 2022-05-07T06:59Z --end-time 2022-05-07T07:59Z --user adbpguser --database adbtest --query-condition Type_:_maxCost_,_Value_:_100 --keyword SELECT --order example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeDiagnosisRecords --region cn-hangzhou --Order 'example-string' --User adbpguser --PageSize 30 --EndTime '2022-05-07T07:59Z' --Keyword SELECT --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2022-05-07T06:59Z' --Database adbtest --QueryCondition 'Type_:_maxCost_,_Value_:_100'
